name: Elite Fabrication and Welding LLC
old_description: We are a family owned and operated fabrication shop since 1980 with over 30 years of experience in building quality products.
about:
Elite Fabrication and Welding LLC operates from West Haven, Utah, where it was founded in 1980 as a family-owned and operated fabrication shop. The company has remained under family stewardship since its inception, building a reputation for custom metalwork across three decades.

The shop provides custom metal fabrication from design through finish, specializing in welding across stainless steel, aluminum, and mild steel. Its service lineup includes metal shearing, hydraulic press forming, plasma cutting, punching, bending, and on-site installation. The facility handles projects of varying scale, with the company noting that no job is too large or too small.

Elite serves a broad customer base worldwide, delivering custom products and services to industrial and commercial clients. While specific industry sectors are not detailed in public materials, the range of processes suggests work for construction, manufacturing, and equipment fabrication.

The company emphasizes its certification in all welding applications and its ability to manage projects from initial design to final installation as key differentiators. Its longevity and family-owned structure are presented as foundations for consistent quality and customer focus.

name: Elite Woodworking
old_description: At Elite Woodworking our devotion is to the finest craftsmanship of custom cabinet doors and drawer fronts. Imagination takes form as the designer's ideas are brought to life by the hands of our skilled artisans. We believe your dreams define the quality of our products regardless of personal style and taste. Elite Woodworking emphasizes the unparalleled beauty and elegance of natural wood design choices for every room in your home. Your custom designs, combined with our artistic visions create beautiful kitchens, bathrooms and other areas of your home.
about:
Elite Woodworking was founded in 1990 in Phoenix, Arizona, by Dan Walker after he completed an apprenticeship at Wilson Custom Cabinets in 1982 and worked two additional years at a small custom cabinet shop. The company remains family-owned and operates from its Melinda Lane facility, which it has occupied since 1999.

The shop manufactures custom cabinet doors and drawer fronts in a wide range of styles — including cope-and-stick, mitered, French light, and carved designs — as well as mouldings and hardware. With a team of about 10 skilled craftsmen, Elite Woodworking produces doors to exact customer specifications for kitchens, bathrooms, and other residential spaces.

The company serves over 100 cabinet makers and private individuals throughout Arizona, supplying both trade professionals and homeowners directly. Its products appear in custom cabinetry projects across the region, from high-end residential kitchens to Habitat for Humanity builds, which the company supports.

Elite Woodworking emphasizes eco-friendly lumber options and a mission to meet precise size and style requirements while delivering the highest quality of craftsmanship. The founder’s original vision — combining the designer’s imagination with the artisan’s skill — continues to guide the business.

about:
Elk Grove Custom Sheet Metal operates from Elk Grove Village, Illinois, in the O'Hare business corridor northwest of Chicago. The company was founded in 1989 and remains family owned and operated.

The shop provides custom sheet metal fabrication, full-service welding (MIG, TIG, and stick), industrial ventilation systems, and design-to-installation services. It produces stainless steel equipment such as work tables, backsplashes, shelving, and carts for food and clean manufacturing environments, as well as plant-floor equipment including conveyors, carts, machine guards, stands, chutes, hoppers, enclosures, and brackets. The team works with steel, stainless steel, aluminum, and other metals, and can reverse engineer parts from samples or sketches.

Customers span food and candy production, packaging and printing, industrial equipment and maintenance, rubber and plastics, and general manufacturing. The company serves businesses throughout the Chicago area with a focus on the O'Hare corridor.

Elk Grove Custom Sheet Metal emphasizes a single point of contact from concept through on-site installation, and states that every job — large or small — receives the same attention to detail.

name: Emcee Electronics Inc
old_description: We make instruments to measure electrical conductivity, water separability, and filterability of explosive liquids.
about:
Emcee Electronics Inc is based in Venice, Florida, where it designs and manufactures instruments for measuring the electrical conductivity, water separability, and filterability of explosive liquids. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The firm's product line consists of precision test instruments that conform to ASTM International standards, including methods D8073, D3948, and D7224, as well as standards from the Energy Institute (formerly the Institute of Petroleum) and ISO. Emcee Electronics provides technical support, training videos, and instruction manuals for its equipment. Facility size, headcount, and production volumes are not published.

The instruments serve customers in aviation fuel testing and petroleum product testing, where water separation and conductivity measurements are critical for flight safety and fuel quality. The company sells through a dealer network and has partnered with PAC to expand its global reach.

Emcee Electronics emphasizes that its products are 100% American made and produced under an ISO 9001:2015 quality management system. The company has published technical analysis arguing that certain ASTM test methods do not reflect real-world coalescing performance, underscoring its focus on test-method validity.

name: Emerald Steel Fabricators Inc
old_description: has been fabricating structural and mechanical projects, machining, sandblasting and painting since 1975.
about:
Emerald Steel Fabricators, Inc. has operated from Eugene, Oregon since its founding in 1975. The family-owned company began as a fabrication shop serving structural and mechanical projects, adding machining, sandblasting, and painting services over the decades.

The 25,400-square-foot facility on five acres houses a full-service fabrication and machine shop. Equipment includes a CNC beam line for cutting and punching beams, channels, angles, and tees; a CNC drill line; and a large array of CNC and manual machines. The shop performs custom welding fabrication to AISC/AWS specifications and runs an enclosed paint and sandblast facility capable of applying various paint systems.

Emerald Steel primarily serves contractors and industrial clients in the Willamette Valley, providing an edge through competitive pricing, quality fabrication, and aggressive delivery schedules. Customers return for hot-rush jobs and R&D projects, relying on the shop's ability to take projects from raw steel through finished, assembled, and painted products at a single location.

The company emphasizes problem-solving on complex projects and a loyalty-driven model built on repeat business. Its team works as a close-knit group, focusing on cost-effective manufacturing and follow-through to ensure final project goals are met.

name: EnaChip Inc.
old_description: In 2013 he returned to Penn to become the Alfred Fitler Moore Professor and Director of Penn’s Singh Center for Nanotechnology. In 2024 he became Chair of Penn’s Department of Electrical and Systems Engineering. Mark’s research is in the area of microelectromechanical systems (MEMS). Beginning with a plenary address to the 1994 IEEE Applied Power Engineering Conference on the topic of integrated inductors, and continuing through today, a major thrust of his program is the realization of microfabricated magnetics for advanced power delivery. He has chaired or co-chaired multiple conferences and co-founded multiple MEMS companies.
about:
EnaChip Inc. operates from Rocky Hill, New Jersey, where it develops high-frequency magnetic components for vertical power delivery in AI data centers. The company was founded to address the growing gap between compute demand and power delivery efficiency, though its exact founding year and ownership structure have not been publicly disclosed.

The company designs and fabricates bespoke magnetics that enable integrated voltage regulator (IVR) and transverse inductor voltage regulator (TLVR) topologies. Its core technology relies on an electroplated core stack with thick copper planar windings and high-flux-density magnetic materials, all processed on standard semiconductor equipment. The resulting components achieve low DC and AC resistance, support switching frequencies above 10 MHz, and fit within sub-millimeter, wafer-level packages that can be placed at the board, package, or die level.

EnaChip serves operators and hardware builders in AI data centers, high-performance computing, and power electronics, particularly those adopting 800 V DC architectures. Its magnetics are designed to integrate with gallium nitride (GaN) and advanced silicon switches, targeting the last few centimeters of power delivery where conversion losses are highest. The company also lists energy harvesting and energy conversion among its served markets.

EnaChip states that its differentiation lies in co-designing power, signal, sensing, and actuation functions rather than stitching together disconnected parts. By electroplating on standard semiconductor lines, the company says it dramatically reduces manufacturing time while delivering magnetics that suppress core loss at high frequencies, enabling low-inductance designs that drop into any level of the design stack.

name: Encompass Manufacturing
old_description: After 35 years in the Plastic Injection Molding industry, we can handle even the most complex projects and would love the opportunity to address your molding needs.
about:
Encompass Manufacturing operates from Cookeville, Tennessee. The company traces its roots back over 35 years, originally founded as Putnam County Plastic Molding by Ricky Sherrell. Today it is certified as a Women's Business Enterprise through WBENC, with Samantha Sherrell serving as president and Ricky Sherrell as vice president.

The company specializes in plastic injection molding supported by a full-service tool shop that handles prototyping, in-house maintenance, and engineering modifications. Its press lineup ranges from 125 to 1,214 tons, enabling a broad spectrum of part sizes. Beyond molding, Encompass offers secondary operations including sonic welding, hot stamping, screen and pad printing, insert molding, vibratory welding, drilling, assembly, and a suite of metrology and material analysis services. A Mattec/MVP monitoring system provides real-time production data and preventive maintenance tracking.

Customers range from small startups to major automotive suppliers worldwide. The quality system, certified to ISO 9001, supports APQP, PPAP, ISIR, and full traceability from raw material through final assembly, all managed through a customized ERP platform.

Encompass emphasizes a culture of quality, integrity, continuous improvement, and shared success. The in-house tool shop and comprehensive secondary services allow customers to complete projects from start to finish at a single location, reducing lead times and logistics complexity.

name: Enercon Engineering LLC, A Generac Company
old_description: Enercon specializes in Low-Voltage and Medium-Voltage Switchgear,
about:
Enercon Engineering LLC, based in East Peoria, Illinois, traces its roots back over four decades to a 5,000-square-foot garage. The company was acquired by Generac Holdings Inc. in April 2026, becoming a subsidiary of the global energy technology leader.

Today Enercon designs and manufactures precision-engineered low- and medium-voltage switchgear (up to 15 kV), industrial control panels, generator docking stations, sound-attenuated enclosures, and mobile power packaging systems. Operations span a 160,000-square-foot facility that includes a 50,000-square-foot electrical assembly area with client-specific production lines, an in-house sheet metal fabrication shop, a military-standard paint booth, and on-site load-testing capacity for generation systems up to 2.5 MW. The company reports more than 50,000 completed projects deployed across 110 countries and has added capacity for an additional 1,000-plus docking stations per year.

Customers include data-center operators, defense and military programs, utilities, hospitals, correctional facilities, and industrial manufacturers. Named references feature Temple University, Waupaca Foundry, the Hampden County Sheriff’s Department, Renaissance, Gen-Alliance, and Oberlander Electric Company.

Enercon emphasizes vertically integrated, engineering-driven manufacturing — handling design, fabrication, integration, PLC/HMI programming, and full functional and load testing in house to UL 891, UL 1558, UL 508A, and MIL-SPEC standards. The firm says this end-to-end control ensures dependable, field-proven power solutions built to perform in extreme environments from -40 °C to +50 °C.

about:
Energy Select operates from Leonardtown in Southern Maryland, with a second office in Western Maryland. The company was founded in Southern Maryland, though no specific year is disclosed in public materials, and ownership structure is not stated.

The firm provides turnkey energy solutions including custom solar photovoltaic system design and installation for residential and commercial clients, battery backup storage, energy-efficient LED lighting retrofits, electric vehicle charger installation, and comprehensive energy analysis. They install Enphase microinverter systems and coordinate with the local utility SMECO to secure rebates for insulation and efficiency upgrades. As a member-owner of the Amicus Solar Cooperative, they collaborate with a national network of independent solar companies.

Energy Select serves homeowners, businesses, and commercial property owners throughout Maryland. Residential customers include owners of historic homes such as a 1927 cottage on Cobb Island. Commercial clients seek LED lighting upgrades, EV charging infrastructure, and backup power systems. The company also performs commercial electrical work.

The company positions itself as a local, full-service energy partner that guides clients through every step of their solar journey, emphasizing energy independence, cost reduction, and carbon footprint reduction. Membership in the Amicus Solar Cooperative is cited as a way to strengthen their ability to serve customers and communities through collaboration.
